# Contact us — by hand

Plain steps by what the page shows, for when no automated method works: follow them with ordinary clicks and typing, or give them to the user. Take every value from the user and never invent one. If a login page, CAPTCHA or two-factor prompt appears, the user has to deal with it.

1. Open the app's /contact page.
2. **The form**
    - Your name: type it (text, 2–60 chars). Required.
    - Email: type it (email address). Required.
    - Topic: choose one (Sales · Support · Billing · Other). Required.
    - Order number: type it (text, ORD- then six digits). Shown only when Topic is Billing.
    - Message: type it (text, 20–2000 chars). Required.
3. Check every value, then click "Send message", and only when the user has asked to submit. It worked if the URL contains /contact/thanks.

## Watch out
- Order number appears only when the topic is Billing.
